digest.component_or_area: Metrics reader over durable ticket event store
propositions: Build read-only metric derivations over the durable ticket event store with clean, verifiable event signatures (attempts-per-ticket, first-pass rate, rework at 7/30 days, reopen-recovery, revert-recovery), excluding unready metrics (escalation, handoff) until separate instrumentation

Implement hybrid data-access pattern: use compiled `reduce_ticket` terminal state for metrics requiring only final values (first_pass_rate, revert_recovery), and raw event files for metrics requiring per-event or multi-occurrence data (attempts, rework windows, reopen counts)
Reuse existing reducer helpers (event_sort_key, is_active_event, RETIRED_SUFFIX) for file traversal and compaction-retired event handling; do not reinvent file-listing or sorting logic
Register metrics into registry with source='structural' and confidence='high'; return None for empty ranges (Unavailable), and 0 for populated ranges with zero qualifying events
Create unit tests demonstrating multi-session attempt counting, rework-within-days time windows, revert targeting discrimination, and retired event inclusion
